set.prevailing_wage_basis: Labor Code 1720(a)(1) covers only construction, alteration, demolition, installation or repair work paid for in whole or in part out of public funds (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720). Section 811 PRA is project-based rental assistance funded by HUD and administered by CalHFA (https://www.calhfa.ca.gov/multifamily/section811/index.htm); it funds no construction, so it does not trigger prevailing wage. Capital sources in the same project are tested separately.

reason: Rental assistance only; 1720(a)(1) covers construction only.

set.prevailing_wage_basis: 2025 MHP Final Guidelines (https://www.hcd.ca.gov/sites/default/files/docs/grants-and-funding/supernofa/2025-mhp-guidelines.pdf) Section 7316(e): the Sponsor shall ensure the construction contract requires compliance with state prevailing wage law (Labor Code 1720 et seq.) and must certify before Program loan closing that prevailing wages have been or will be paid; Section 7314(e) adds a pre-disbursement prevailing wage certification. Applies to every MHP-funded project, no unit threshold. Labor Code 1720(c)(5) applies its private residential exemptions only "unless otherwise required by a public funding program" (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720), so this program requirement governs.

reason: MHP Guidelines Section 7316(e) require prevailing wage in the construction contract.
